    Push-down of representations along a quiver morphism #

    For a morphism of finite quivers p : D → Q and a representation X of D, the push-down p_*X of Construction 3.12 has (p_*X)(q) = ⊕_{p(i) = q} X(i) and, along an arrow c of Q, the block X(e) : X(i) → X(j) for each arrow e : i → j of D with label c. We realize it directly as a module over the path algebra kQ on the total space ⊕_i X(i) (Rep.Tot): the vertex idempotent e_q acts as the projection onto ⊕_{p(i)=q} X(i) and an arrow c acts as the sum of the arrow operators of the arrows labelled c. For p the identity this is the usual module of a representation of Q.

    Maps of total spaces are handled through their blocks: Rep.idm X i is the idempotent projection onto X(i).
